description: Discriminator: with Durable enabled and an instance whose bal, vbal, Status and Seq all differ, does the record contain the value written for bal at the offset the writer used? Prefix: the harness creates a temp file, constructs a Replica with Durable true and StableStore set to that file, and calls the real recordInstanceMetadata and sync. Controls: the same event prints the whole header in hex together with which written value appears at offset 0, so a harness mistake in constructing the instance would be visible.

harness.description: In-package Go test that runs the real metadata recorder against a temp stable store and reports the resulting header bytes.
semantic_changes: harness-only scaffolding: the Replica is constructed in-package instead of through New(), the stable store is a harness temp file, and the instance is built directly with distinct field values; the recorder and sync under test are the unmodified implementation

legality.derivation: The check observes exactly what the recorder writes for one instance; no protocol behaviour is modified and no expected bytes are assumed, the header being reported verbatim.
legality.applicability: Durable true, one instance, N=3, distinct bal/vbal/Status/Seq.
unresolved: no in-repository reader fixes the intended layout

grounding.derivation: The event reports the header the recorder produced together with flags for the values written at their offsets, so the comparison is against the function's own writes rather than against a fabricated layout.
grounding.applicability: A record of the expected length was produced.

observable_properties.description: The record must contain the value written for bal at the offset where the recorder wrote it.

uncertainties: The check does not read the record back through a production reader, because none exists in the snapshot.
Only one instance is recorded; repeated records and the deps region are not compared.
